title: 01_severe_sbp_hr_overlay
interpretation: Severe arm over 72 h: the extraction's systolic-pressure and heart-rate milestones lag the engine by ~11 h (SBP<100 at 37.5 h vs 26.6 h; HR>90 at 37.6 h vs 26.8 h). Dotted lines mark the SBP<100 and HR>90 thresholds. This is the systolic half of the picture; on the MAP<65 shock threshold the order flips (see the study-05 milestone dumbbell).
